Quick answers

How reliable are these predictions?

Results are based on the last published CAP Round cutoff data. Every year's cutoffs move slightly, so treat this as a strong starting shortlist rather than a guarantee.

What does Safe / Target / Reach mean?

Safe means your score is well above last year's cutoff. Target is close to the cutoff line. Reach is below it, but worth keeping as a stretch option.

Which reservation categories are covered?

Every Maharashtra CAP category is included — GOPENS, OBC, SC, ST, VJ/DT, NT, SEBC, EWS, TFWS, PWD, and Defence.
